name: Chamber of the Guildpact
description: The Chamber of the Guildpact is the petition hall and seat of the Living Guildpact in Gateway Plaza on Ravnica.

bio.text: Jace held appointments and ruled on guild disputes there as the Living Guildpact, and Gideon collapsed on its steps seeking his help.

timeline.summary: After the Supreme Verdict, the Chamber is built in Gateway Plaza on the ashes of Jace's former sanctum, and Jace tells Lavinia the site 'seemed fitting'.
timeline.quote: Seemed fitting,

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "Original construction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
timeline.quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Lavinia shows Jace that victims of petrification were found in Rozlad Square arranged to spell his name.
timeline.quote: They spell out your name.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes that the victims' names match planes, realizes a planeswalker is targeting him, and insists on going alone to Rozlad Square.
timeline.quote: Clear out all your officers and mages from Rozlad Square. I'm going alone.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives in Ravnica at the Chamber of the Guildpact, intending to ask Jace for help, and collapses on the steps.
timeline.quote: Gideon ascended the first step, tried for another, but gravity had him, and he collapsed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace finishes a day of tedious petitions as the Living Guildpact and returns to his secret apartments.
timeline.quote: "Guildpact," said Lavinia. He turned. "Get some rest."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Chamber of the Guildpact is destroyed by the Planar Bridge and again in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by the Planar Bridge , and again during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "Plazas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Chamber of the Guildpact falls silent, its promise broken.
timeline.quote: The Chamber of the Guildpact has fallen silent, its bright promise broken.

citation.text: Gateway Plaza (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Planar Bridge opens over the Chamber of the Guildpact and reduces it to rubble.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.

citation.text: Emergence Zone (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Guild leaders focus magic on the portal scar where the Chamber perished.
timeline.quote: Guild leaders focused their magic on the portal scar.

citation.text: Gateway Plaza (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Bolas orders Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop the Chamber, stripping Jace of his Guildpact power and wrecking the embassy with Ajani, Chandra, Jaya and Karn inside.
timeline.quote: the Chamber was catastrophically damaged when Nicol Bolas ordered Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop it

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane leads a ritual at the ruined Chamber, restoring leylines and resurrecting Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: resurrecting Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane leads the guild representatives through a ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet at the ruined Chamber of the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane led the representatives through a ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: God-Eternal Kefnet attacks the ritual and Teyo Verada shields the participants until it is completed; Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon on his chest.
timeline.quote: Teyo Verada shielded the guild representatives and bystanders long enough for the ritual to be completed.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reborn, Niv-Mizzet incinerates Kefnet and loses consciousness from the strain.
timeline.quote: Upon his rebirth, the Firemind incinerated Kefnet

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing it to rubble, and the Dreadhorde invades Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret opened up the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact on Ravnica, reducing it to rubble

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vitu-Ghazi and the Chamber of the Guildpact are nearly destroyed with significant loss of life.
timeline.quote: Heavy damage was done, including the near-destruction of Vitu-Ghazi and the Chamber of the Guildpact , with significant loss of life.

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the compleated Vraska orders the Chamber breached and desecrated.
timeline.quote: Under her orders, the Chamber of the Guildpact was breached and desecrated

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek stands atop the ruins of the Chamber and uses a device to disrupt Vraska's compleation, wounding her and scattering her swarm.
timeline.quote: critically wounding her and scattering her swarm

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces destroy the roof of the Chamber of the Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet's seat.
timeline.quote: delighting in crushing Niv-Mizzet's seat

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek fights through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska, and hits her sternum with a cylindrical device attuned to Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
timeline.quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska lies dying beneath rubble, half-flesh and half-metal, awaiting death.
timeline.quote: Now, I close my eyes and wait for the death Phyrexia promised I would never face alone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet continues to reside in the Chamber under reconstruction, restoring only his chair.
timeline.quote: leaving the Guildpact's chair as the only component of the chamber to have been fully repaired

citation.text: "Chamber of the Guildpact", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark the Planar Bridge destroys the buildings around the Chamber of the Guildpact, creating Gateway Plaza.
timeline.quote: an open space created when the Planar Bridge destroyed the buildings around the Chamber of the Guildpact during the War of the Spark

citation.text: "Precinct One", section "Neighborhoods and Landmarks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Honest Jace, in a memory-prison, recounts the experiment born from trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion to build a Multiverse without monsters.
timeline.quote: An experiment ignited by our trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion of the entire Multiverse

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist visits the Guildpact for counsel and has him check his proofs, which show the overlay is collapsing.
timeline.quote: "It's collapsing," concludes the Guildpact.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reveals that he stores the Multiverse map in the Theorix cadets.
timeline.quote: "No, in the cadets."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Guildpact calls the Theorist a machine that can't even kill one oracle and warns he intends to overwrite their home; the Theorist puts him to sleep.
timeline.quote: The Theorist flicks a hand, and the Guildpact collapses to the rubble with a sick thud, dead asleep.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.
